final: SELECT o.orderflow, AVG(NULLIF(e.fillcount, 0)) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions AS e2 JOIN orders AS o2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS fraction_of_executions FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow
